lines.name: Mesmerize line (single-target mez)

members.name: Glamour of Kintaz
members.note: Mez cap L57 - the ONLY sub-59 mez that lands on L56-57 mobs; also 30% memblur; only 30s

members.name: Rapture
members.note: Mez cap L61; 40% memblur; only 24s and a 24s recast - raid-tier, not a general upgrade

replacement.note: Strict by duration/mana-efficiency through Dazzle (L47): each of Mesmerize -> Enthrall -> Entrance -> Dazzle is a straight duration upgrade at the same L55 target cap, so lower ranks are fully superseded. It STOPS being strict at the top: Glamour of Kintaz (cap 57) and Rapture (cap 61) raise the level cap but SHORTEN duration (30s / 24s) and cost 275/425 mana vs Dazzle 125. Enchanters keep Dazzle memmed alongside them - Dazzle for <=55 targets, Glamour/Rapture only when the target is 56+. Rapture additionally has a 24s recast so it cannot chain-mez. Legends effect strings encode the caps directly: Mesmerize/Enthrall/Entrance/Dazzle/Mesmerization/Fascination all read "Mesmerize (2/55)", Glamour of Kintaz "(2/57)", Rapture "(2/61)" - agreeing exactly with the P99 cheatsheet Max-lvl column.

missingOnLegends: Ancient: Eternal Rapture (live L60 ancient mez)

conflicts.detail: Mez does not stack with itself - recasting refreshes/overwrites. Landing a second mez on a mezzed mob just resets the timer.

stacksWith.detail: Every enchanter mez carries a 1% memblur rider (Glamour 30%, Rapture 40%); a separate Memory Blur cast still applies.

stacking.notes: Mez breaks on damage. All mezzes are Magic-resist checked, which is why the Tash line is cast first.

members.name: Entrancing Lights
members.note: PBAE, cap L55 but only 6s - a panic/"get off me" AE, not the Mesmerization upgrade

replacement.note: Mesmerization -> Fascination is a strict upgrade (same 55 cap, 24s -> 36s). Entrancing Lights is NOT in that chain: it is point-blank AE with a 6-second duration, kept as an emergency break rather than replaced. Legends level 30 for Entrancing Lights and 52 for Fascination match Allakhazam exactly.

conflicts.detail: Same effect slot; an AE mez landing on an already-mezzed mob overwrites the single-target timer (usually downward).

stacking.notes: AE mez aggros everything in radius that resists - the classic reason Tash-then-AE-mez is the pull order.

members.name: Boltran's Agacerie
members.note: up to L53; 400 mana, shorter duration (7 min on P99) - a cap raiser, not an efficiency upgrade

members.name: Dictate
members.note: up to L58; 750 mana, 48s duration, 5 min recast - raid tool

replacement.note: Strict through Allure (L46): each step raises the charmable level cap while keeping ~16-20 min duration, so the lower rank is dead weight. Breaks at the top - Boltran's Agacerie (7 min) and especially Dictate (48s, 5 min recast, 750 mana) trade duration/efficiency for cap. A L60 enchanter still casts Allure for anything <=51.

conflicts.line: Necromancer Dominate Undead line / Druid Beguile Animals line
conflicts.detail: One charm per mob; recharming overwrites.

stacksWith.line: Haste line, AC line, Rune line, Str line
stacksWith.detail: A charmed pet takes normal enchanter buffs; haste on a charmed mob is the core of enchanter soloing.

stacking.notes: Charm is Magic-checked; Tash first. Charm break = the mob is instantly hostile with full aggro.

replacement.note: Blur rates rise (10% -> 25% -> 30%) but mana rises faster (40 -> 100 -> 350) and Reoccurring Amnesia carries a 24s recast. Memory Blur stays memmed at 60 as the cheap spam-blur; Memory Flux is the "must land now" blur. P99 wiki flags the published blur percentages as disputed.

stacksWith.detail: Mez already carries a 1% blur; a dedicated blur on top is independent.

stacking.notes: Blur is a chance roll, not a buff - no slot contention. Failure is silent, which is why enchanters chain-cast it.

lines.name: AE memblur line (Mind Wipe / Blanket of Forgetfulness)

members.name: Blanket of Forgetfulness
members.note: Targeted AE; Legends shows two 20% memblur components (P99 lists an effective 36%)

replacement.note: Blanket of Forgetfulness strictly supersedes Mind Wipe (higher rate, same targeting).

stacking.notes: Chance roll per mob in radius; no slot contention.

members.name: Wake of Tranquility
members.note: Targeted AE version, radius 1, 300 mana - group-pull tool, not a single-target upgrade

replacement.note: Strict for the single-target chain: each step shrinks the residual aggro radius (15 -> 10 -> 5 -> 1) at higher mana. Wake of Tranquility is the AE sibling of Pacify (same radius 1), kept alongside Pacify rather than replacing it - 300 mana per cast. Legends levels (1/6/18/35/51) match Allakhazam; P99 classic runs 1/9/20/39/51.

conflicts.detail: Same effect family; a weaker lull landing on a mob already lulled by a stronger one is wasted/overwrites.

stacking.notes: Resisted lulls aggro the mob - the standard failure mode. All are Magic-checked.

members.name: Instill
members.note: 96s. Legends/live name; the P99 cheatsheet spells the same L29 root 'Enstill'. Legends row has no parsed effects but the 1m36s duration matches root exactly.

members.name: Fetter
members.note: 3 min, 75 mana, 1.75s cast - best on every axis

replacement.note: Not strict in the middle. Immobilize (L39) is SHORTER than Instill (60s vs 96s) but casts in 1.75s vs 2.5s - it is the emergency/interrupt root, not a duration upgrade. Fetter (L58) is strictly better than everything (3 min, 75 mana, 1.75s). Note Legends L25 for Instill matches Allakhazam; P99 classic has it at 29.

conflicts.detail: One root per mob; recast overwrites the timer.

stacksWith.detail: Root and slow are different effects and coexist.

stacking.notes: Root breaks on damage (chance per hit). Magic-checked.

replacement.note: Duration climbs to Invoke Fear then drops slightly at Trepidation; the real progression is the (undocumented in this DB) max-level check. Trepidation is kept for high-level targets, Invoke Fear for everything else. Rarely used by enchanters outside of soloing - feared mobs train.

conflicts.detail: Same effect; overwrites.

stacking.notes: Magic-checked.

replacement.note: Strict: each step adds stun duration and radius. Color Slant adds a mana drain rider. All are capped at L55 targets per P99. Legends levels 3/20/43/52 vs P99 4/20/44/52.

conflicts.detail: Stun timers do not add; the longer remaining stun wins.

stacking.notes: Unresistable stun below the level cap - the classic enchanter "oh no" button and the basis of AE-stun-tanking.

members.name: Dyn's Dizzying Draught
members.note: SpinStun + AC/AGI debuff + 50 mana/tick drain; 35s recast

members.name: Largarn`s Lamentation
members.note: 8s stun + 75 mana drain, 24s recast. Legends spells it with a backtick.

replacement.note: Not a clean chain. Dyn's Dizzying Draught has a 35s recast so it cannot replace Whirl Till You Hurl as a spammable stun; Largarn's Lamentation is a mana-drain-first spell that happens to stun. All three coexist in a L60 spellbook for different jobs.

conflicts.detail: Stun component shares the stun timer.

members.name: Dementing Visions
members.note: 775 on Legends. Note: this is the one member with NO stun component - the line loses its stun rider at the top.

replacement.note: Strict on damage and on mana-per-damage all the way up (0.94 -> 0.37 mp/dmg). The one exception is at the very top: every member through Dementia carries a "Stun for 0.0 seconds" rider (a real interrupt), and Dementing Visions drops it. Enchanters who nuke for interrupts keep Dementia memmed past 58. Legends 7/16/21/32/43/54/58 matches Allakhazam; P99 runs 8/16/24/34/44/54.

stacking.notes: Instant damage - no buff slot. Magic-checked.

members.name: Shallow Breath
members.note: Legends L1; 3 ticks, no per-tick component parsed - the newbie stub of the line

replacement.note: Strict - each step improves both total damage and mana-per-damage (0.59 -> 0.26). Every member also carries the same STR/AGI debuff rider, which does NOT stack with itself, so overwriting a running DoT with the next rank is safe. Enchanter DoTs are a poor damage source; the line is mostly used for the debuff and for pulling.

conflicts.detail: Two ranks cannot run on one mob - the newer cast replaces the older.
The DoTs' STR/AGI rider competes with the dedicated STR debuff line; the larger value normally holds and the weaker cast is refused.

lines.name: Mana drain line (Mana Sieve / Theft of Thought)

members.name: Mana Sieve
members.note: Instant, drains 214-370 target mana, no return

members.name: Theft of Thought
members.note: Drains 346-400 AND transfers it to the caster; 25 mana, 2 min recast

replacement.note: Theft of Thought is strictly better per cast (cheaper, returns the mana) but has a 120s recast; Mana Sieve stays memmed as the spammable drain when the goal is stripping a caster mob rather than gaining mana.

stacking.notes: Instant effects - no slot contention.

lines.name: Mana-drain-over-time line (Wandering Mind / Torment of Argli)

members.name: Wandering Mind
members.note: -6 target mana/tick, +6 caster mana/tick recourse; 5 mana to cast, 150s recast - the classic enchanter mana battery

members.name: Torment of Argli
members.note: -35 mana/tick + HP damage + INT/WIS drain; 150 mana, 10s recast

replacement.note: Different jobs, not an upgrade chain. Wandering Mind is a nearly-free self-sustain tap (5 mana, 150s recast) with a caster recourse; Torment of Argli is a 150-mana offensive drain with no return. Both stay memmed.

conflicts.detail: Torment of Argli's INT/WIS drain occupies the same debuff family as Curse of the Simple Mind.

stacking.notes: Wandering Mind is a target debuff plus a self recourse buff - the recourse regen is its own effect and stacks with Clarity-line regen.

replacement.note: Strict - each is a bigger attack-speed reduction at the same 3 min duration. Enchanter slows top out at 70% vs shaman 75% (Turgur's Insects), so on P99/classic a shaman slow is preferred when both are present.

conflicts.detail: Same attack-speed slot. The stronger slow holds; a weaker slow cast over a stronger one is refused ("your spell did not take hold").
Also attack-speed negative; does not add to a spell slow.

stacksWith.detail: Slow (attack speed) and Cripple (STR/AGI/AC) are separate slots and are the standard pair on a raid mob.
Different slot entirely (magic resist).

stacking.notes: Slow is the enchanter's single most valuable group contribution below the level where a shaman out-slows them.

members.name: Tashina
members.note: Legends L2, matching Allakhazam. Absent from the P99 cheatsheet's Tash table entirely - classic P99 starts the line at Tashan L4. Legends shows Tashina with Tashan's exact magnitudes (9@L4 to 13@L8); Allakhazam gives Tashina -6 (L2) to -18 (L9). DISCREPANCY - see openQuestions.

members.name: Tashan
members.note: -9 to -13 MR; 10 mana, 1.0s cast - never leaves the spellbook

replacement.note: Strict on magnitude. The practical caveat is mana: Tashan is 10 mana at 1.0s cast vs Tashanian 40 mana, and because the MR debuff is what makes mez/charm land, enchanters often cast the CHEAP one on trash and the big one on named. All ranks are unresistable, which is the whole point of the line.

conflicts.detail: Ranks overwrite; a weaker Tash over a stronger one is refused.

stacksWith.detail: CONFIRMED STACKING: the shaman Malo line is a separate resist-debuff slot from Tash. Tash + Malo together is the standard raid resist-strip and the two magnitudes ADD.

stacksWith.line: Enchanter Cripple line and Slow line
stacksWith.detail: Entirely different stats.

stacking.notes: Tash is unresistable, so it is always cast first in a CC opener. This is the enchanter debuff that most directly multiplies the rest of the class kit.

lines.name: Wind of Tashani line (AE magic resist debuff)

members.name: Wind of Tashani
members.note: DUPLICATE ROW in the Legends DB - identical name, level and effects. Almost certainly one spell double-listed.

members.name: Wind of Tishanian
members.note: Targeted AE, -40 MR. Allakhazam spells this "Wind of Tashanian"; the P99 cheatsheet spells the L55 one "Wind of Tishani". Legends has swapped the i/a between the two ranks.

replacement.note: Strict: -23 MR -> -40 MR, same targeting.

conflicts.detail: Same slot as single-target Tash - the AE will overwrite a weaker single Tash and vice versa.

stacksWith.detail: Separate slot; adds.

replacement.note: Strict on magnitude. In practice the whole line is superseded in group play by the Cripple line (Disempower/Listless Power/Incapacitate/Cripple), which debuffs STR *and* AGI *and* AC in one cast - the pure-STR line is a low-level filler.

conflicts.detail: Both write the STR debuff slot; the larger STR reduction holds and the other cast is refused. Casting Weakness on a Crippled mob does nothing.
DoT STR/AGI riders share this slot.

replacement.note: Strict - each rank increases every component. Cripple adds a DEX component the lower ranks lack. Together with slow this is the enchanter's melee-damage mitigation package.

conflicts.detail: Same spell name/effect family on shaman; does not stack.
Shares the STR debuff slot - do not follow Cripple with Weakness.

stacksWith.detail: Different slot (attack speed). Slow + Cripple is the standard pair.
Different slot (resists).

lines.name: Haste line (Quickness -> Wonderous Rapidity)
sharedWith: Items (Speed of the Shissar, Sandals of Alacrity, haste potions)

members.name: Augmentation
members.note: +22-28% BUT also +AGI and +AC and 27 min duration - a utility buff, weaker haste than Alacrity

members.name: Swift Like The Wind
members.note: DUPLICATE ROW in the Legends DB (identical +60% effect). L47 matches Allakhazam, L49 matches P99 classic - looks like both level records got imported.

members.name: Augment
members.note: +43-45% plus +AGI/+AC - the Augmentation upgrade, still not the top haste

members.name: Visions of Grandeur
members.note: +58% haste plus +40 AGI/+25 DEX/+20 ATK, 42 min - LOWER haste than Wonderous Rapidity, taken for the stat package and duration

replacement.note: NOT strict, and this is the single most misread enchanter line. Two sub-branches share one slot: the pure-haste chain (Quickness -> Alacrity -> Celerity -> Swift Like The Wind -> Aanya's Quickening -> Wonderous Rapidity) and the utility chain (Augmentation -> Augment -> Visions of Grandeur) which trades ~15-25% haste for AGI/AC/DEX/ATK and much longer duration. A L60 enchanter keeps Wonderous Rapidity (70% for the main melee) AND Visions of Grandeur (58% + stats, 42 min, cheap upkeep) memmed at the same time. Because they share the Haste (Primary) slot they CANNOT both be on one target.

conflicts.detail: Identical spells on shaman - same slot, no stacking. Shaman Celerity is +50%, capped below enchanter top-end.
Haste (Primary).

conflicts.line: Bard haste songs (Jonthan's Inspiration +63%, Vilia's Chorus +45%, Verses of Victory +30%, Anthem De Arms +10%, McVaxius' Berserker Crescendo +23%)
conflicts.detail: All Haste (Primary). A bard singing Jonthan's Inspiration on a target already under Wonderous Rapidity gains nothing.

conflicts.line: Item haste (Speed of the Shissar +66%, Graveyard Dust +65%, Dance of the Blade +55%, Flurry potions, Illusion: Werewolf +40%)
conflicts.detail: Also Haste (Primary) - clicky/potion haste does NOT stack with enchanter haste. Note Illusion: Werewolf carries +40% haste in this same slot.

CAVEAT: "worn" haste (the % on an equipped item, e.g. a haste belt) is a DIFFERENT system from spell haste and does stack up to the overall haste cap - see the P99 Haste Guide. Only spell/clicky-cast haste is in this slot.

stacksWith.line: Bard Composition of Ervaj (+10%) / Melody of Ervaj (+5%)
stacksWith.detail: The Haste ("Ervaj"/v2) slot is separate. Wonderous Rapidity +70% plus Composition of Ervaj +10% = +80%, the documented spell-haste maximum.
Augmentation/Augment write AC Slot 3, not Slot 4, so Augment and Umbra both apply.
Augmentation/Augment/Visions of Grandeur AGI sits in the "Agility (Speed Augmentation)" slot, separate from the shaman Agility (Primary) line - both apply.

stacking.notes: Slot names verbatim from P99 Buff Lines: "Haste (Primary)" and "Haste (Ervaj/v2)". Max spell haste = +80%.

lines.name: Clarity line (mana regeneration)

members.name: Boon of the Clear Mind
members.note: +6 to +9 mana/tick, GROUP. Legends L42 = Allakhazam; P99 classic has it at 52.

replacement.note: Magnitude is strict (2 -> 7 -> 9 -> 11 -> 11) but targeting is NOT, so lower ranks stay in the book. Boon of the Clear Mind (group, +9) is worse per-person than Clarity II (single, +11), so a L54-58 enchanter alternates: C2 on the casters who matter, BoCM on the group. Gift of Pure Thought finally makes the group version equal to the single version and retires both. Breeze survives only as the level-14-to-26 stopgap. NOTE the Legends retier: Boon of the Clear Mind at 42 instead of the classic 52 hands enchanters group mana regen ten levels early - the largest gameplay-affecting level difference in the class.

missingOnLegends: Koadic's Endless Intellect (live L60, group, the true capstone of this line - present on live Allakhazam at 60 but ABSENT from the Legends DB)

conflicts.line: Itself - every member of this line
conflicts.detail: Breeze, Clarity, Boon of the Clear Mind, Clarity II and Gift of Pure Thought ALL occupy the single "Mana Regeneration (Clarity)" slot. Only one can be on a character. Casting group BoCM over someone's Clarity II strips them down to +9 - the classic raid-buff griefing accident.

stacksWith.line: Gift line (Gift of Magic / Gift of Insight / Gift of Brilliance)
stacksWith.detail: Separate slot: "Mana Regeneration (Gift)". Gift of Insight +1/tick and Gift of Brilliance +2/tick ADD on top of Clarity II. This is the enchanter stacking their own two regen buffs on one target.

stacksWith.line: Bard Cassindra's Chorus of Clarity (L32) / Cassindra's Chant of Clarity (L20)
stacksWith.detail: Separate slot: "Mana Regeneration (Chorus)". Chorus is +7 base, and because it is a burst-per-pulse rather than a duration buff a bard who manually re-pulses it every 3s delivers an effective +14/tick. Multiple bards STACK with each other on this - each extra bard pulsing adds another +14. Unaffected by instruments/Puretone.

stacksWith.line: Bard Cantata of Replenishment (L55) / Cantata of Soothing (L34)
stacksWith.detail: Separate slot: "Mana Regeneration (Cantata)". +13/tick. Stacks with Chorus AND with Clarity - one bard can run Cantata while another pulses Chorus.
Separate slot: "Mana Regeneration (Protection of the Glades)". +6/tick.

stacksWith.line: Necromancer Lich line (Dark Pact -> Demi Lich)
stacksWith.detail: Separate slot: "Mana Regeneration (Lich)", self-only, +2 to +31/tick at an HP cost. Stacks with everything above.

stacksWith.line: Self-only caster regen (Wizard/Necro Manaskin +1, Barrier of Force click +3)
stacksWith.detail: Separate slot: "Mana Regeneration (Self-Only)".

stacksWith.line: Item mana regen ("Flowing Thought" worn items)
stacksWith.detail: P99 Buff Lines gives Flowing Thought its OWN column in the mana-regen table (+8 for wizard/necro, +6 druid), separate from every spell slot, and excludes it from the spell maximum - i.e. worn FT mana regen stacks on top of Clarity, Gift, Cantata and Chorus. Meditation (the skill, +21) is likewise a separate bucket.

stacking.notes: THE MANA-REGEN ANSWER: there are seven independent mana-regen buckets - Clarity (enchanter), Gift (enchanter), Chorus (bard), Cantata (bard), Protection of the Glades (druid), Lich (necro), Self-Only, plus non-spell Meditation and worn Flowing Thought. Everything across buckets ADDS; nothing within a bucket does. P99 documents the practical ceiling for a Magician/Enchanter as +46/tick with one bard (6 PotG + 11 Clarity II + 2 Gift of Brilliance + 13 Cantata + 14 pulsed Chorus), and notes each ADDITIONAL bard pulsing Chorus adds another +14 with no cap - four extra bards is +56 more. Legends caveat: with Koadic's Endless Intellect missing, the Clarity bucket tops out at +11 (Clarity II / Gift of Pure Thought).

replacement.note: Strict on both components. All three are Velious-era additions (marked "Vel" on the P99 cheatsheet).

conflicts.detail: One Gift at a time - "Mana (Primary)" holds all three and there is no other class in it.

stacksWith.detail: CONFIRMED: distinct slot ("Mana Regeneration (Gift)" vs "(Clarity)"). Gift of Brilliance +2/tick sits on top of Clarity II +11/tick for +13 from the enchanter alone.

stacksWith.line: Druid Mask of the Hunter / Form of the Howler
stacksWith.detail: Those druid self-buffs ARE in the Gift slot (+3 / +2) - a druid running Mask of the Hunter will refuse Gift of Brilliance's regen component.

stacking.notes: Gift of Magic gives max mana only, so it contributes to "Mana (Primary)" but contributes 0 to the regen table.

stacksWith.detail: Layer-2 AC slots - all stack.

conflicts.detail: Shares the HP (Shielding/Talisman) slot. Shaman Focus of Spirit (+405 HP) beats Shield of the Magi (+250) - the HP component is refused, and on P99 that means the whole spell may not land.

conflicts.detail: AC (Slot 2).

conflicts.detail: NO conflict - see stacksWith. The Shielding MR is in "Magic Shield", a separate slot from MR (Primary).

AC Slot 2 vs Slot 4.
HP (Primary) vs HP (Shielding/Talisman) - Aegolism/Symbol stack with Shield of the Magi.

missingOnLegends: Rune of Zebuxoruk / Rune of the Scale (live L61)

stacksWith.detail: Separate slots.

sharedWith: Druid (Strength of Earth -> Girdle of Karana)

members.name: Rampage
members.note: +29 to +42 STR, +79 to +90 damage absorb, -20 AGI, ~5 min

conflicts.detail: Strength (Primary). Shaman out-buffs enchanter STR at every tier from 29 up.

conflicts.line: Druid Strength of Earth -> Girdle of Karana (+42)
conflicts.detail: Strength (Primary).
Rampage's +90 absorb is in Damage Absorption (Primary) with the Runes - it will clobber a real rune. Berserker Spirit's +200 absorb is in the separate Berserker slot and does NOT.
Berserker Spirit shares "Damage Absorption (Berserker)" with Berserker Strength (+50) and Bedlam (+350) - only one of those three absorbs at a time.

stacksWith.line: Bard Anthem De Arms / Chant of Battle / Jonthan's

openQuestions: Tashina (Legends L2): the Legends DB gives it Tashan's exact magnitudes (-9 @L4 to -13 @L8), but Allakhazam gives Tashina -6 (L2) to -18 (L9) - i.e. a WEAKER floor and a HIGHER ceiling than Tashan. If Allakhazam is right, Tashina out-scales Tashan by L9 and the line order Tashina->Tashan is wrong at high level. P99 omits Tashina from the Tash table entirely (classic P99 starts at Tashan L4). Needs a direct look at the Legends spell data to decide whether the magnitude was copied from Tashan by mistake.

Legends 'Instill' (L25) vs P99 'Enstill' (L29): Allakhazam has 'Instill' at ENC/25, so Legends is following live naming. The Legends row has NO parsed effects at all - only a 1m36s duration - so the Root effect is inferred from the duration matching Enstill/Instill exactly. Worth confirming the effect list is genuinely empty in the source data rather than a parse failure.

Four duplicate rows in the input (239 rows, 235 distinct spells): 'Wind of Tashani' L55 twice (byte-identical), 'Swift Like The Wind' at both L47 (live level) and L49 (P99 classic level), 'Invisibility versus Undead'/'Invisibility Versus Undead' both at L14 with different effect encodings, and 'Illusion: Air Elemental' at both L29 (elemental) and L45 (whose illusion id is 'Imp'). The L45 Air Elemental is the only one that might be a genuinely distinct spell - it is not on Allakhazam or P99 at that level.

Ward/Guard of Alendar stacking is INFERRED, not sourced. They are LDoN adventure-point spells and appear nowhere in the P99 Buff Lines tables, so the claim that their spell-damage mitigation is a separate slot from the melee Rune line rests on the effect type (Mitigate Spell Damage vs Absorb Damage), not on a classic stacking source.

Legends is missing Koadic's Endless Intellect (live ENC/60) even though it carries the rest of the live Clarity line including Gift of Pure Thought at 59. If that is deliberate, the Clarity slot caps at +11/tick on Legends; if it is a data gap, the mana-regen ceiling changes for every caster on the server. This is the single most consequential absence found.

The DB reports Legends 'Wonderous Rapidity' (Allakhazam spells it 'Wondrous Rapidity') and 'Wind of Tishanian' (Allakhazam: 'Wind of Tashanian'). Purely cosmetic unless something keys off exact names.

Rune I-IV effect strings in the Legends DB are unparsed ('UNKNOWN CALC 111 base 27 max 55 attrib Absorb Damage'). The base/max numbers match P99 exactly, so the values are right, but a consumer of this DB cannot read them without handling calc 111-114.
